statement: A request that sends a header with different values, when any statement, policy condition, boundary or rate limit key of the documents its view reads reads that header (`http.header.<name>`, or `Origin` and `Referer` through `http.origin` and `http.referer`), is answered 400 before evaluation, whatever the effect of the statement and whether it applies to the request; identical repeats are one value, and a header no document reads is not checked.
guards: engine:CompiledDocumentTest#a document knows the headers it reads
testkit:KitHeadersTest#a header sent in two cases with different values is refused, whichever comes last
testkit:KitHeadersTest#identical repeats are one value, by the kit as by the pipeline
testkit:KitHeadersTest#a header no document reads is not checked
testkit:KitHeadersTest#Origin and Referer are checked the same way
